title: When required
text:
20.04.140 When required.
Except as stated herein, a detailed site development plan is required prior to development in a special purpose district or with a special permit application and may be required if a zoning condition exists on a particular piece of property. Detailed site development plans are not required for apartment or mixed-use residential development that meet all minimum requirements set forth in Chapter 20.12 (Density and Dimensional Standards) and Section 20.10.363 or for any projects for development in the mixed-use district (RMU, GMU and IMU) or for any other projects other than those located in special purpose districts or as otherwise required herein.
(Ord. 16915 § 1, 2008: Ord. 16653 § 2 (part), 2007)
(Ord. No. 019815, § 2, 11-18-2025)
